title: TYPO3 Blog: overview film
description: Posts are pages, styled by Desiderio. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 55 seconds: TYPO3 Blog for TYPO3 v14. Posts are pages; All posts in one list; Metadata and a featured image; Comments you approve. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Many blog add-ons keep posts in their own tables, with their own editor and their own rules.
The TYPO3 Blog extension turns pages into posts, and Desiderio gives them your theme.
Editors write posts in the page module, with the content elements they know.
The Posts module lists every post with author, categories, tags and date.
Posts open with the date, the title, a teaser and the reading time.
Readers comment under the post, and editors can approve each comment first.
